source.title: Binance Web3 API — RWA Data
source.downloadableSchema: The documentation page's schema-download link timed out during this review; findings below describe the rendered official documentation, not a retrieved OpenAPI file.

platforms.tickerCount: Number of underlying assets corresponding to RWA tokens.
platforms.chainDistributionTokenCount: Number of RWA tokens on a chain; the same underlying asset deployed on different chains is counted separately.
platforms.responseTimestamp: Server response time in Unix milliseconds.

filters.binanceChainId: Optional; omitted returns data from all chains.
filters.tabId: Optional sector filter; omitted returns all sectors; documented values are 1 through 13.

tokens.documentedResponseShape: A data array of RWA tokenized assets plus an envelope-level server timestamp.

search.requiredQuery: keyword (ticker, company name, or contract address)
search.results: Matched ticker rows containing tokenized assets across platforms and chains.
search.chainFilter: The rendered endpoint documentation does not list a chainId query parameter.

price.identity: binanceChainId plus comma-separated tokenContractAddresses; up to 100 addresses per request.
price.perAssetTimestamp: tokenPriceUpdatedAt is distinct from the envelope-level server timestamp.

boundedCatalogObservation.declaredBscTokenCountBasis: Sum platform chainDistribution.tokenCount entries for binanceChainId 56; this is not platform tickerCount.
boundedCatalogObservation.returnedUniqueBscRepresentationsBasis: Distinct normalized BSC identities (chainId plus lowercase token contract address) in the observed token-list rows.
boundedCatalogObservation.interpretation: The observed difference remains unexplained. The official rendered documentation does not define pagination or a total-count contract for the token-list endpoint. Pagination cannot be asserted as the cause; upstream completeness remains unverified.
boundedCatalogObservation.tabFilterObservation: Two tabId queries returned equal identity sets in this sample; that does not prove that the filter is ignored.

implementationFidelity.assetType: The SDK retains the documented numeric asset type from search and token-list results; unknown integer codes remain visible rather than being relabeled.
implementationFidelity.marketState: The SDK preserves the provider's detailed market status and documented reason/open/close context alongside a conservative normalized state used by safety checks.
implementationFidelity.timestamps: Envelope and per-asset price timestamps retain distinct provenance. Missing timestamps are not synthesized, and timestamp presence is not treated as a freshness guarantee.
implementationFidelity.safety: Provider pause, unknown state, invalid time values, and contradictory open-state fields do not become evidence that a market is safely open.

boundedConclusion: This record summarizes the rendered official documentation and local source review. It does not establish complete catalog coverage, runtime pagination behavior, or a quote-freshness service level agreement.
